Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Peter Matthiessen died of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) and attributed this to reputable sources (e.g., NPR), despite the retrieved sources (notably NPR) explicitly stating acute myeloid leukemia (AML).
